name: Black Jaguar
subtitle: Jungle Prowler
description: Pounce on your Foes weakening their armor and inflicted deadly strike to enemies under Buffs.
lore: The people of Omeyocan revere the jaguar, but the black jaguar holds special meaning. Representing inner strength and transformation, it is believed to possess a mystical power. Since the Shattering, the black jaguars have indeed taken on a strength beyond their more common kin. They seem, as well, to have developed purpose, as they stalk the enemies of the gods.
divinity_generator: Gain [20] Divinity when inflicting damage to an enemy.

skills.name: Nimble Swipe
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 2 times with a 20% chance to gain an [Extra Turn].

skills.name: Prowling Strike
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 250%ATK with a 50% chance to place [mechanic:def-down-i] on the target for 1 turn.

skills.name: Vicious Roar
skills.description: Place [mechanic:sharpen-ii] on this hero for 2 turns then attack 1 enemy 300%ATK. If the target has any [Buff], inflict 25% increased damage.
